# uBit (ubit)

> Native macOS (`arm64`) video and audio downloader and CLI with NDJSON output, clip extraction, MP4/M4A muxing, system audio conversion and a built-in WebKit browser. The macOS executable must be under 2,000,000 bytes and its archive under 1,100,000 bytes.

## Agent & LLM Documentation

- [Agent & Automation CLI Guide](docs/agents.md): NDJSON events, exit codes (`0`, `1`, `2`, `130`), `--quiet` path capture, `--section` rules and when byte ranges help, terminal provider refusals (401/403/407/410/429/451 and challenges), WAV extraction, and `UBIT_CONFIG_DIR` isolation.
- [Installable Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`)](skills/ubit/SKILL.md): Ready-to-use skill definition for Claude Code, Codex, OMP, and `npx skills add https://github.com/ayooooo123/ubit`.
- [Contributor & Codebase Guide (`AGENTS.md`)](AGENTS.md): File layout, zero-dependency architecture invariants, two-pass `co64` MP4 muxer rules, terminal provider-refusal rules, and E2E verification commands.
- [Project Overview (`README.md`)](README.md): Size benchmarks vs. Downbit 0.2.4, install one-liner, and interactive CLI/GUI usage.

## Quick Commands for Agents

```sh
ubit --llms
ubit info --json "<url>"
ubit get -q 720 --section 0:30-1:00 --no-library --quiet -o /tmp "<url>"
ubit get -a --to wav --no-library --quiet -o /tmp "<url>"
```
